key_insight: Quantum Broker distributes a circuit’s measurement shots across heterogeneous QPUs to meet user-defined cost, latency, and fidelity requirements.
engineering_relevance: Its provider-agnostic execution layer helps engineers manage backend selection and shot allocation across fragmented quantum cloud platforms.
method: Express QoS constraints and optimization objectives declaratively with QQSpec.
Profile backends through interchangeable strategies and exploit measurement-shot independence for distributed execution.
Plan shot allocations using mixed-integer linear programming or nonlinear dual annealing.
evidence_signal: Benchmark circuits evaluated on noisy simulator backends showed feasible QoS-aware allocations and improved QoS satisfaction over single-backend and naive multi-backend baselines.
watch_item: Simulator-based results do not establish live-hardware performance, and higher-quality nonlinear allocations require more planning time.
paper_title: Quantum Broker: QoS-Aware Distribution of Quantum Computations
